text: On or about XX/XX/XXXX I received again the following documents from ELLS FARGO in the letter attached it specifically states under documentation requests We apologize that we are unable to meet your request and provide specific reasons for this process. To do so would jeopardize the integrity of our investigations so again theyre denying to provide me authenticated evidence i.e documents, call logs, names, anything to support their findings of the transactions withdrawn from my account XX/XX/XXXX by a XXXX XXXXXXXX being valid or no error occurred but also refusing to reissue my securities back to my account. They also reissued copies of my bank statements which Wells Fargo has been made aware that bank statements are false and misleading representation of evidence and omitted from material facts, statements only show there is an account but it doesnt prove that I was aware of the transactions nor did I give consent, or have knowledge of the transactions in question being taken from my account.
